'''Emergency Services''' was an organization that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. They utilized [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] [[Ambulance/Legends|ambulances]] and were deployed to [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] crashes to rescue the passengers.
